limitations: Reference validation selects the best masked-reconstruction epoch; its reported minimum is not an unbiased third-test estimate.
Reconstruction improvement does not imply downstream improvement.
Ten CV repeats describe split variability, not ten independent biological replications.
Reference preprocessing is fitted only on reference train, then frozen; held-out genotypes never enter that fit.
CUDA scatter reductions may be nondeterministic; seeds and RNG states are saved, but bitwise device reproducibility is not promised.

reference.identity_rule: Second raw CSV header ecotype ID -> raw column; metadata positions are never genotype indices.
reference.external_note: All non-dormancy name candidates are transformed for provenance, including ambiguous ones. No ambiguous phenotype matching or external outcome evaluation is performed here.

locked_experiment.selection: Pooled inner-validation MSE; tie uses lambda grid order.
locked_experiment.policy: Locked widths/seeds; no downstream-best encoder selection.

reference.fit_population: REFERENCE TRAIN ONLY: allele counts, minor alleles, allele means, 3 SNP-loading PCs, LD, flat channel mean/std. Reference validation only applies frozen transforms.
reference.minor_rule: Least frequent positive-count A/C/G/T allele in reference train; monomorphic/all-uncalled SNPs are constant zero indicators. Missing or unseen non-minor alleles map to zero.
reference.pca_rule: 25x25-or-smaller covariance eigendecomposition, top3 descending; largest-absolute SNP loading positive. Eigenvalues <=1e-12 give zero PC. Apply (minor indicator - frozen allele mean) @ frozen loading.
reference.graph_rule: Coordinate adjacency + same-chromosome next50 candidate blocks, within1Mb, top3 absolute reference-train mean-dosage correlations >=0.5. Bidirectional/self-loop/virtual edges; legacy six-feature encoding.
reference.preprocessing_note: Identical frozen independent-reference preprocessing; only the prespecified epoch schedule changes from25 to100 in the new run.

16.interpretation: Descriptive average over all three locked seeds, not selection and not an independent-replication significance test.

64.interpretation: Descriptive average over all three locked seeds, not selection and not an independent-replication significance test.

zero_or_negative_gain_conditions.metric: downstream mean-repeat Pearson trained minus untrained

overall_interpretation: Masked reconstruction improves against measured validation training-mean baselines, but downstream gains are small and metric/seed dependent; do not claim robust pretrained-encoder superiority. All locked conditions, including negative results, are retained.
